record.paper_title: Multiplier sequences, classes of generalized Bessel functions and open problems
record.original_question: Let {gamma_k}_{k>=0} be a sequence of nonnegative real numbers such that f(x)=sum_{k>=0} gamma_k x^k/k! is an entire function. For every parameter p with -p not in N, define F_p(x)=sum_{k>=0} gamma_k x^k/(k! Gamma(k+p+1)). Characterize exactly which such sequences {gamma_k} have the property that F_p belongs to the Laguerre-Polya class L-P of real entire functions, meaning the class of real entire functions admitting the standard Laguerre-Polya product representation with only real zeros, for every admissible p.

evidence.quote: Problem 8. Characterize all non-negative sequences {gamma_k}_0^infinity such that if f(x) = sum_{k=0}^infinity gamma_k x^k/k! is an entire function, then F_p(x) = sum_{k=0}^infinity gamma_k x^k/(k!Gamma(k + p + 1)) belongs to L - P, for -p notin N.

Definition 2. A real entire function phi(x) = sum gamma_k x^k/k! is said to belong to the Laguerre-Polya class, written phi in L - P, if it admits the representation phi(x) = c x^m e^{-a x^2 + bx} product_k (1 + x/x_k)e^{-x/x_k}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{L}\text{-}\mathcal{P}$ denote the Laguerre–Pólya class of real entire functions, i.e., the class of real entire functions $\varphi$ admitting a representation of the form
$$\varphi(x) = c\, x^{m} e^{-a x^{2} + b x} \prod_{k}\left(1 + \frac{x}{x_{k}}\right) e^{-x/x_{k}},$$
where $c, b, x_{k} \in \mathbb{R}$, $a \geq 0$, $m \in \mathbb{N}_{0}$, and $\sum_{k} 1/x_{k}^{2} < \infty$.

Let $\{\gamma_{k}\}_{k \geq 0}$ be a sequence of nonnegative real numbers such that
$$f(x) = \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \frac{\gamma_{k}}{k!}\, x^{k}$$
defines an entire function. For each real parameter $p$ with $-p \notin \mathbb{N} = \{1, 2, 3, \ldots\}$, define the associated generalized Bessel-type function
$$F_{p}(x) = \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \frac{\gamma_{k}}{k!\,\Gamma(k + p + 1)}\, x^{k}.$$

Give an exact characterization of all such nonnegative sequences $\{\gamma_{k}\}_{k \geq 0}$ for which $F_{p} \in \mathcal{L}\text{-}\mathcal{P}$ for every admissible $p$ (i.e., every real $p$ with $-p \notin \mathbb{N}$).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open problem in the literature on multiplier sequences and generalized Bessel functions. Recent work characterizes multiplier sequences for generalized Laguerre bases and Fox–Wright extensions, but no complete characterization of nonnegative sequences making $F_p$ belong to the Laguerre–Pólya class for all admissible $p$ appears to have been established.

status_evidence.snippet: The research concludes with several open questions, including problems on characterizing sequences related to generalized Bessel-type functions in the Laguerre-Pólya class.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization is explicitly listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: The Fox–Wright functions and Laguerre multiplier sequences
status_evidence.snippet: Studies multiplier sequences arising from Fox-Wright type functions and the Laguerre-Pólya class.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work addresses related but not identical characterization questions.
